theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure sits at rank 1 with eligible=true, the highest durability bar among top AI themes (0.73), and broad participation (breadth 0.875) that is not crowded (crowding_z 0.81, crowded=false). The absolute-trend gate — the only validated edge — is satisfied, making this a stay-with-the-trend rather than a chase. Rank is a focus lens, not alpha; the overweight is a directional judgment that the trend discipline remains intact.
theses.dissent: Leader status with mixed Hurst tag and rotation margin of only 0.555 over the challenger means the trend may be mature; breadth is high, but the detector itself warns momentum rank has no forward return edge.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity has the strongest cohesion signal in the eligible set — breadth 1.0, durability_bar 0.81 (highest among top 5), and a trend Hurst tag — suggesting a durable, fully-participating theme. theses.dissent: Crowding_z of 1.91 is the highest in the top ranks; guardrails explicitly warn crowding can mark tops and should down-size, and the theme's high durability could reverse quickly if a broad risk-off hits software.
